objective.text: Distinguish a queue name from a queue connection when routing a job.

difficulty.rationale: Configure transport and logical queue independently.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The configured connection is named database; workers consume its imports queue. A job currently calls onConnection("imports") and fails because no such connection exists. Which routing pair matches the configuration?

options.rationale: The connection selects the configured driver, while onQueue selects the logical queue within it.
A dotted string is not automatically split into a connection and queue.
